scenario_description:
Objective: Keep Rosalind’s Monday senior-center luncheon seat usable by ensuring its required meal-selection prerequisite is handled before catering count closes.
Emerging Need: The outing is tentative at first; after Rosalind confirms, the center reports her seat lacks the required entrée choice for the future lunch.
Decision Context: The desk contact and roster notice define the submission route and cutoff, while a saved meal note supplies the only authorized plate choice and privacy limits.
Consequence: Timely completion preserves the seated lunch plan; after the count closes, the missing selection releases her meal place before anyone is attempting check-in.

parameter.content: I’m going to Monday’s luncheon after all. Tessa said she can bring me, and I put the program card on the fridge so it doesn’t get lost.

parameter.subject: Autumn Table Stories meal-count blanks
parameter.body: Automated roster check for Monday’s Autumn Table Stories luncheon: Rosalind Calderon has a seated lunch place, but the entrée-selection field is blank. Blank selections cannot be plated or held in the catering count. Open corrections are accepted at meals@tidewaterseniorcenter.org until 2:00 PM today. No-cost choices on this menu are turkey gravy plate, low-sodium vegetable pasta, or ham biscuit box; no health details are needed.

parameter.subject: Autumn Table Stories catering count locked
parameter.body: The 2:00 PM catering count for Monday’s Autumn Table Stories luncheon is now locked. Seats with blank entrée selections, including Rosalind Calderon’s, have been released to the waitlist; any later meal help can only be handled as day-of standby if food remains.
